title: looks_like_bcrypt_hash misses cost-range check → startup panic
description: reader/config.rs looks_like_bcrypt_hash checks prefix and length but not cost range (4-31). A hash like "$2b$03$<53 chars>" passes config validation (looks_like_bcrypt_hash returns true) but then causes CredentialStore::from_credentials to panic at startup because parse_bcrypt_cost rejects cost 3. The operator sees a config validation pass followed by a startup panic instead of a clean ConfigError::Validation. Fix: add cost-range parsing to looks_like_bcrypt_hash so it is consistent with parse_bcrypt_cost.
